name: Adzviser Klaviyo
description:
Connect your Klaviyo data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files — Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about campaigns, flows, and revenue. Compare open, click and conversion rates, dig into list growth and segment performance, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Klaviyo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Klaviyo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://klaviyo.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Klaviyo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Klaviyo provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_klaviyo, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Klaviyo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Klaviyo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Klaviyo MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Klaviyo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Klaviyo is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
